subjects.description: A large bright orange decorative arrow painted on the road surface, curving and pointing sharply to the right toward a side street
subjects.appearance_details: Vivid fluorescent orange paint with crisp edges, matte finish, oversized proportions atypical of standard traffic markings, clearly a temporary decorative marking for a film shoot
subjects.relationship: The primary visual distractor on the pavement that the ego vehicle deliberately ignores
subjects.location: center foreground on the road surface
subjects.orientation: Painted flat on the ground, arrowhead angled toward the right side street
subjects.action: Remains stationary on the pavement as the vehicle approaches and passes over its base
subjects.state_changes: Grows larger in frame as the vehicle approaches, then slides toward the bottom and right of frame as the car continues straight.

subjects.description: Film crew barriers lining the entrance of the side street on the right
subjects.appearance_details: Metal crowd-control barricades and orange plastic barriers, some with attached warning strips, positioned to cordon off the side street
subjects.relationship: Indicate the side street is part of a film shoot and is closed to normal traffic
subjects.orientation: Arranged across and along the side street entrance, facing the main road
subjects.pose: Static, lined up in a row
subjects.action: Stationary as the vehicle drives past
subjects.state_changes: Pass by on the right and exit the frame as the vehicle proceeds straight.

subjects.description: The main city road ahead with regular white lane markings
subjects.appearance_details: Grey asphalt with fresh white dashed and solid lane lines, buildings and street furniture flanking both sides
subjects.relationship: The path the ego vehicle continues along, contradicting the decorative arrow
subjects.orientation: Extends straight ahead away from the camera
subjects.action: Recedes toward the vanishing point as the vehicle advances
subjects.state_changes: White markings flow steadily beneath the camera as the vehicle maintains speed.

background_setting: A clear daytime urban city street with multi-story buildings, shopfronts, and street furniture lining both sides. The main road runs straight ahead with regular white lane markings on grey asphalt. On the right, a side street branches off, cordoned by film crew barriers. A bright orange decorative arrow painted on the pavement dominates the near road surface, pointing sharply toward the closed side street. Consistent hard shadows fall across the road under strong sunlight.

lighting.direction: High sun, slightly front-left, casting consistent shadows
lighting.shadows: Sharp, well-defined shadows from buildings and barriers falling consistently across the road surface
lighting.illumination_effect: High contrast, well-lit scene with vivid saturated colors, making the orange arrow especially prominent

aesthetics.composition: Ego-perspective dashcam framing with the road centered, the orange arrow occupying the lower-center foreground, the side street and barriers on the right, and the main road converging at a central vanishing point
aesthetics.color_scheme: Grey asphalt, crisp white lane lines, dominant fluorescent orange arrow and barriers, muted urban building tones under blue sky
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating white dashed lane markings and lined-up barrier segments

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking shot from the ego vehicle moving straight at cruising speed; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.focus: The road ahead, orange arrow, and side street all in sharp focus

context: Autonomous driving scenario testing whether the ego vehicle correctly ignores a non-standard decorative pavement marking

actions.description: The ego vehicle cruises straight ahead as the bright orange arrow becomes prominent in the foreground, pointing toward the barrier-lined side street on the right. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle approaches and passes over the base of the arrow, ignoring its rightward direction and maintaining speed. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle continues straight along the main road with regular white markings; the side street and barriers pass by on the right and exit the frame. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

segments.description: The ego vehicle approaches the large orange decorative arrow pointing toward the right side street lined with film crew barriers, without slowing. temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view shows a clear sunny city street with a large fluorescent orange arrow painted on the pavement in the foreground, curving to point right toward a side street cordoned by film crew barriers. By 0:01 the vehicle continues at cruising speed, the arrow enlarging in frame. At 0:02 the car reaches and drives over the base of the arrow, disregarding its rightward direction. From 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle proceeds straight ahead along the main road with regular white lane markings, the side street and barriers passing by on the right and leaving the frame as the road recedes to the horizon. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Steady ambient city driving sounds: the low continuous hum of the car's engine and tires on asphalt at cruising speed, faint distant traffic and urban background noise, no speech or music.
